repo_notes.content: docs/ and README.md are the source of truth. Where code and docs disagree, describe the code and say the docs differ. Do not state rule counts or version numbers; link docs/rules.md and the Maven Central badge instead.

A rule id is a freeze-store key: it names a file in every consumer's committed archunit/frozen/ store. Ids are never renamed or removed, and rewording a rule's predicate resurfaces old violations. Explain this wherever ids, freezing or upgrades come up.

Stress the silent failure modes the docs call out: ImportOption.DoNotIncludeTests makes test rules pass vacuously; not committing the freeze store, or pinning allowStoreCreation, re-freezes real violations; an unwired group is not enforced.
Published to Maven Central as io.github.milczekt1:corral-rules and io.github.milczekt1:corral-sdk. Java 17 baseline. corral-example is a test fixture, not a published artifact.
